title: ARCADE: OPERATOR LOCK
why: His yes to recommendation 1 for the Halloween party mode. Guests play the party machine, so they must not be able to leave the arcade or wander into Settings, character select, the stash or the Mainframe. The only way out of the arcade is now a keyboard chord for the operator: Ctrl+Shift+F10, from a raid, the bench, the demo screen or the initials card. In an arcade raid the pause box shows only RESUME and END RUN, and on the demo screen MENU, ESC or P opens no pause box at all. Normal raids are untouched.
